description: This file provides a function to set environment variables in a way compatible with Git's internal utilities, including input validation, memory allocation, and calling putenv.

methods.name: int gitsetenv(const char * name,const char * value,int replace)
methods.description: Sets an environment variable with the specified name and value. Validates input, checks existing value if not replacing, allocates memory for the environment string, and uses putenv to set it.

ctags.name: gitsetenv
ctags.pattern: /^int gitsetenv(const char *name, const char *value, int replace)$/
